# Vectorshift

The End-to-End AI Automations Platform for building and deploying AI workflows, pipelines, chatbots, and knowledge bases.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/vectorshift/.

## Actions

- **Create Chatbot**: Create a new chatbot.
- **Get Chatbot** (read-only): Fetch an existing chatbot by its ID or name.
- **Get Pipeline** (read-only): Fetch an existing pipeline by its ID or name.
- **List Chatbots** (read-only): List all available chatbots in the account.
- **List Knowledge Bases** (read-only): List all available knowledge bases in your VectorShift account.
- **List Pipelines** (read-only): List all available pipelines in the VectorShift account.
- **Run Pipeline**: Run a VectorShift pipeline with the given inputs.
- **Run Pipeline in Bulk**: Run a VectorShift pipeline in bulk with multiple sets of inputs.
- **Delete Chatbot**: Delete a chatbot by its ID.
- **Get Knowledge Base** (read-only): Fetch an existing knowledge base by its ID or name.
- **List Transformations** (read-only): List all available transformations in the account.
- **Terminate Pipeline Execution**: Terminate a running pipeline execution.
